message:
Command `cd /workspace && loc=$(awk 'tolower($1)=="location:"{sub(/\r$/,"",$2); print $2}' /tmp/headers.txt); echo "$loc" > /tmp/loc.txt; echo ${#loc}; python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import urlparse
u=open('/tmp/loc.txt').read().strip(); print(u[:500]); print(urlparse(u))
PY
for ip in $(getent ahostsv4 storage.googleapis.com | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | head -10); do echo IP $ip; timeout 40 curl -4 --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 40 -L -H 'Host: storage.googleapis.com' --resolve storage.googleapis.com:443:$ip "$(cat /tmp/loc.txt)" -o /workspace/of_download.bin -w 'code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n' || true; ls -l /workspace/of_download.bin 2>/dev/null && break; done
